newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-ITAUSA TARGET PRICE RAISED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ITAUSA TARGET PRICE RAISED.

text.p: ING Barings said it had raised its June 1998 price target for Brazil's Itausa, holding company for Banco Itau, to $1.31 from $1.13 per share.
-- also said it had reiterated its buy rating on Itausa's preferred stock following the upgrade of Banco Itau to buy from hold.
-- Analysts Nuno Fernandes and Beltran Estrada said they expect Itausa, which is due to report second quarter earnings results on August 13, to post earnings of $0.02 per share.
-- They also said they continue to believe that Itausa remains the most attractive way to play Banco Itau.

-- "Besides trading at a 18 percent discount versus the sum of its parts, Itausa's new price target represents a total return of 38 percent by June 1998, including a three percent dividend yield," they said.
-- No trades were seen with Itausa's stock in the first half hour of trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa Friday.
